content.title: Who is Amy Madigan's husband? Behind her four-decade marriage to Ed Harris
content.text: Veteran actress Amy Madigan has enjoyed a decades-long career in Hollywood, with memorable roles in films such as Field of Dreams and Uncle Buck. But away from the spotlight, the actress has also been part of one of the entertainment industry's most enduring marriages.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoMadigan has been married for more than four decades to fellow actor Ed Harris, forming a partnership that has lasted both on and off screen.Amy Madigan's husband is actor Ed HarrisAmy Madigan is married to Ed Harris, an acclaimed actor known for films like Apollo 13, The Truman Show, Pollock, and the HBO series Westworld. Harris is a four-time Academy Award nominee and one of the most respected performers of his generation.The couple tied the knot on November 21, 1983, after working together during the production of the film Places in the Heart.Their relationship began earlier in the early 1980s, when Madigan saw Harris performing in a play and felt an immediate connection. Soon after, the two began collaborating professionally, which eventually led to their marriage.A marriage that has lasted more than 40 yearsMadigan and Harris are often cited as one of Hollywood's longest-lasting couples. Over the years, they have also collaborated creatively, appearing together in several films and stage productions.Their relationship is built on mutual respect and a shared passion for acting. The two have frequently supported each other's projects and major career moments, including award-season appearances.Their daughter followed their path into actingMadigan and Harris share one child together, Lily Dolores Harris, who was born in 1993. Lily has also pursued a career in the entertainment industry, working as an actress, producer, and director.Despite their fame, the family has largely kept their personal lives private, rarely sharing details publicly.Their enduring marriage - spanning film sets, theater stages, and awards seasons - remains one of the quiet success stories in Hollywood.
